2607.17043.title: Learning from Synthetic Data without Model Collapse in Iterative Instruction Tuning
2607.17043.paper_summary: Model collapse is a central challenge in learning from synthetic data: as later-generation large language models (LLMs) are trained on an increasing proportion of model-generated data, performance can degrade due to narrowed coverage and accumulated bias. Existing work mainly studies how to bound this degradation. In iterative model evolution, however, the more meaningful objective is to ensure that each successive model improves over its predecessor, which requires diagnosing collapse at a granularity that is actionable for data curation. We study this problem in synthetic data self-improving for instruction tuning. We show that collapse in this setting is not simply uniform performance degradation, but can appear as a polarization of competence, where synthetic training reinforces already strong skills while further degrading weak ones. Motivated by this observation, we propose KITE (Knowledge-boundary Instruction Tuning via Exploration), a two-stage framework that combines failure-guided data generation with boundary-aware uncertainty curation. Experiments across several datasets and multiple open-source LLMs show that KITE yields more stable improvement than strong synthetic-data baselines.
2607.17043.paper_summary_zh: 模型崩潰是從合成數據學習中的一個核心挑戰：隨著後續世代的大型語言模型（LLMs）在越來越多的模型生成數據上進行訓練，性能可能因為覆蓋範圍狹窄和累積偏見而下降。現有的研究主要探討如何限制這種退化。然而，在迭代模型演進中，更有意義的目標是確保每個後續模型比其前身有所改善，這需要在可操作的數據策劃層面上診斷崩潰。我們在合成數據自我改進的指令調整中研究這個問題。我們顯示，在這種情況下的崩潰不僅僅是均勻的性能退化，而是可以表現為能力的極化，其中合成訓練加強了已經強大的技能，同時進一步削弱了弱技能。基於這一觀察，我們提出了KITE（知識邊界指令調整透過探索），這是一個兩階段的框架，結合了失敗引導的數據生成與邊界感知的不確定性策劃。在多個數據集和多個開源LLM上的實驗顯示，KITE比強大的合成數據基準產生了更穩定的改進。
